text: Almost everyone walks past these at Walmart
a portable charger for your body.
Take a few dates, remove the pits,
and soften them until they get nice and sticky.
Then mix them with chopped walnuts
and 50 grams of chocolate protein powder.
It's packed with protein, takes almost no effort to make,
and you can bring it pretty much anywhere.
Coat it in coconut flakes and let it chill for an hour.
It's sweet, filling, easy to carry,
and perfect for work, the gym, running errands,
When your body wants something sweet
and your brain wants another coffee,
comment dates and I'll send you the recipe written out.
